name: Nahor
overview: Nahor appears in Scripture as both the grandfather of Abraham and Abraham's brother, establishing his significant role in the patriarchal lineage central to God's redemptive plan. Genesis 11 records Nahor's birth to Serug and later Terah's fathering of Nahor alongside Abram and Haran, highlighting his place in the family line from which Christ would eventually come. The narrative also emphasizes Nahor's marriage to Milcah, his niece, and the continuation of his descendants, including Rebekah, who becomes a key figure in God's covenant promises to Abraham's family. These details underscore Nahor's part in God's providential unfolding of salvation history.
